articles.summary: SIMEUP becomes the first medical society in Italy to partner with Vera Health, the medical search engine used by more than one in four doctors in the country and an official AI partner of the American College of Emergency Physicians.
articles.title: SIMEUP and Vera Health Join Forces to Elevate Pediatric Emergency Medicine

articles.summary: Clinicians using Vera can now consult the American Diabetes Association’s Standards of Care in Diabetes and professional resources in seconds, cited and linked to the original source.
articles.title: The American Diabetes Association and Vera Health Collaborate to Expand Access to the Standards of Care in Diabetes
